About us

Who we are

Scottish Printing and Packaging is your trusted partner for high-quality printing and packaging. We print custom boxes of every type, with a special focus on elegant sweet boxes that make your confectionery, bakery, and gift products stand out. We also produce premium books, from novels and textbooks to children’s and coffee table books, with crisp printing and careful binding.

Our process

How your boxes are printed

Eight steps take a box from an idea to your door.

  1. 1

    Design and artwork

    Your box design and artwork are prepared, checked and approved by you.

  2. 2

    Plates and material

    Print plates are made and the right paper or board is selected.

  3. 3

    Printing

    Approved artwork is printed on the board using colour printing presses.

  4. 4

    Finishing

    Coatings such as lamination or UV varnish add protection and shine.

  5. 5

    Die-cutting

    Sheets are cut and creased into the exact shape of the box.

  6. 6

    Folding and gluing

    Boxes are folded and glued, ready to be formed.

  7. 7

    Quality check

    Every batch is inspected for colour, cuts and strength.

  8. 8

    Packing and delivery

    Finished boxes are counted, packed and delivered to you.

FAQ

Questions customers ask

Quick answers before you get in touch.

Can you make boxes in my size?

Yes. We make boxes to your size and design.

Which boxes do you make?

Boxes of all kinds, including gift, retail, shipping and carton boxes.

Do you print books?

Yes. We publish high quality books with a premium finish.

Are you FBR certified?

Yes. We are an FBR certified business, established in 2017.

How do I get a price?

Send a quote request with your product, size, quantity and your artwork or idea.

What about order size and delivery time?

Tell us your quantity and deadline in your quote request and we will confirm both.
